thesis: Google's $350+ billion revenue engine is built almost entirely on advertising, with search dominance and YouTube generating the core cash while cloud and subscription products emerge as future growth drivers.

facts.claim: Google advertising generated $264.6 billion in 2024 revenue, comprising 76% of Alphabet's total $350 billion, driven primarily by search.
Google Search & other contributed $198.1 billion in 2024, making it the single largest revenue source, while YouTube ads generated $36.1 billion.
Google Cloud revenues surged 82% year-over-year to $24.8 billion in Q2 2026, driven by enterprise AI infrastructure and solutions.
Google Services also includes subscriptions, platforms, and devices which generated $40.3 billion in 2024, reflecting growing paid consumer products beyond free search.
Alphabet reported 12 consecutive quarters of double-digit revenue growth through Q2 2026, with consolidated revenues reaching $119.8 billion.
Google Cloud had $462.3 billion in remaining performance obligations as of March 2026, representing future contracted revenue that has not yet been recognized.

verified_numbers.context: Google advertising revenue in 2024, representing 76% of Alphabet total revenue
Google Search & other revenue in 2024, the largest single product revenue
Google Cloud revenue in Q2 2026, up 82% year-over-year
Alphabet's anticipated 2026 CapEx investment range, primarily for AI and infrastructure

timeline.event: Google Services revenue reached $304.9 billion; Google advertising hit $264.6 billion, establishing search as dominant revenue engine
Google Cloud accumulated $462.3 billion in remaining performance obligations, signaling enterprise shift to cloud and AI services
